answer: A sybil tax makes it costly to forge identities: each new identity pays a non-refundable 30-credit creation tax, burned not staked, and files a fresh key-signed work signal for one verified job. The rate is a public signal from the ocean-wide ledger: the k-th identity from one key pays 30+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,027,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented signal covers one filing; reuse burns it. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its share.
